Opaque drawable surface in Notcurses, composed of cells. Forward-declared only.
Opaque multimedia visual/image/video object. Forward-declared only.
Opaque plot widget for uint64_t data. Forward-declared only.
Opaque plot widget for double data. Forward-declared only.
Opaque progress bar widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque plane-associated fd streaming helper. Forward-declared only.
Opaque subprocess wrapper integrated with an ncfdplane. Forward-declared only.
Opaque single-selection widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque multi-selection widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque freeform text input widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque fade context for palette fade operations. Forward-declared only.
Opaque grouped item used within an ncreel. Forward-declared only.
Opaque hierarchical scrolling reel widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque tab item within nctabbed widget. Forward-declared only.
Opaque tabbed widget container. Forward-declared only.
Opaque direct mode context (no planes). Forward-declared only; not constructed in this header.

  NCBLIT_DEFAULT,

objects.description: Enumeration of cell blitters used to approximate pixel graphics or plots.
Horizontal/vertical alignment within a plane or terminal.
Scaling modes used when rendering ncvisuals.
Cell type storing one EGC, style mask, and 64-bit channels (fg/bg color+alpha). Used extensively by plane APIs.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
  NCLOGLEVEL_SILENT = -1,
  NCLOGLEVEL_PANIC = 0,
  NCLOGLEVEL_FATAL = 1,
  NCLOGLEVEL_ERROR = 2,
  NCLOGLEVEL_WARNING = 3,
  NCLOGLEVEL_INFO = 4,
  NCLOGLEVEL_VERBOSE = 5,
  NCLOGLEVEL_DEBUG = 6,

} ncloglevel_e;
objects.description: Logging levels for Notcurses and libav-compatible granularity.
Configuration for notcurses_init/core_init: terminal type, log level, margins, flags.
Input event type (press/repeat/release/unknown).
Input event structure for keyboard/mouse; holds codepoint/special id, modifiers, coordinates, and derived text.
Palette store for indexed color terminals; each entry holds a channel (RGB).
Derived terminal capability set (color depth, unicode block support, etc.). Returned read-only by API.
Enumeration of pixel-graphics backends supported in the environment.
Cumulative and current statistics about rendering, I/O, and resources.
Rendering options for ncvisual blits: target plane/placement, scaling, subregion, blitter, flags, transparency, pixel offsets.
Computed geometry description for an ncvisual under given rendering options and environment.
Item entry for ncselector: label and optional description.
Configuration for ncselector widget, including text channels and items.
Item entry for ncmultiselector with initial selection state.
Configuration for ncmultiselector widget, including items and channels.
Tree node specification used to build an nctree; each has user data, an array of subitems, and count.
Configuration for nctree: initial items, callback, indentation and flags.
Menu item descriptor: label and a shortcut key.
Menu section containing a name, items, and a section shortcut.
Configuration for ncmenu: sections, styling channels, flags.
Styling and direction flags for progress bar corners and behavior.
Styling and behavior options for nctabbed widget.
Options for ncplot widgets (both uint64 and double) including colors, grid, range, title, flags.
Options for ncfdplane: user data, tail-follow, and flags.
Options for ncsubproc: user data, watchdog restart period, flags.
Options for text reader: channels, attributes, and behavior flags.

Opaque direct-mode Notcurses context type referenced throughout this header. It is forward-declared only (no definition present here). Used to manipulate terminal directly without full notcurses rendering lifecycle.

objects.definition: typedef struct ncplane ncdirectv;
objects.description: Typedef alias used by the direct-mode image rendering APIs to represent a renderable/rasterizable visual buffer tied to ncplane. It is an alias of struct ncplane defined elsewhere; only the typedef is introduced here.

objects.definition: typedef struct ncvisual ncdirectf;
objects.description: Typedef alias naming a loaded media frame handle for direct-mode workflows. It aliases struct ncvisual, which is defined elsewhere; only the typedef is introduced here.
Built-in C boolean type from <stdbool.h>. It is not defined in this header; included here only via standard header. Excluded per instructions.
Unsigned 32-bit integer type from <stdint.h>. It is not defined in this header; included here only via standard header. Excluded per instructions.

This header defines no custom data types (no structs, enums, typedefs, or classes). It only provides platform-dependent includes and macros (e.g., htole) for endianness and placeholder wcwidth/wcswidth on some platforms.

Forward-declared/indirectly referenced C++ class. This header does not define any types; it only includes NotCurses.hh (which presumably defines ncpp::NotCurses) and notcurses.h. Because the class is not defined here, and no other structs/enums/typedefs/classes are introduced in this file, there is no definition present in this header.

C++ RAII-style wrapper around a notcurses context. Manages initialization, lifetime, and access to the underlying C notcurses* along with helpers (input, rendering, palette, stats, mouse, etc.). It is non-copyable and non-movable; a single global instance is tracked via a static pointer. Details of construction and destruction are in the corresponding implementation file and depend on notcurses_options.

C++ RAII wrapper around a notcurses ncplane, providing creation, duplication, parenting/reparenting, geometry, drawing, styling, and content APIs. Manages lifetime of the underlying ncplane except when marked as stdplane. Supports various constructors for aligned/offset creation and duplication, and integrates with NotCurses instance management via Root.

C++ wrapper class around a notcurses nccell providing RAII-style ownership and convenience methods for style, color, and alpha manipulation. It stores an nccell as a private member and exposes conversions to nccell* and const nccell*. Construction can default-initialize the cell or initialize from a Unicode codepoint, or from codepoint, attributes, and channels. Destruction/cleanup details are not present here; based on notcurses, callers should ensure any extended grapheme clusters allocated within nccell are freed appropriately (not shown in this header).

Strongly-typed bitflag enum of text styling attributes for notcurses cells within the ncpp namespace. Values map to underlying notcurses NCSTYLE_* flags and can be combined via bitwise operators provided by DECLARE_ENUM_FLAG_OPERATORS. Intended to express underline, bold, italic, struckthrough, and undercurl styles. Construction is by value; no dynamic ownership semantics apply.

C++ RAII wrapper around notcurses direct-mode (ncdirect). Manages a live ncdirect* and exposes convenience methods for terminal drawing, styling, cursor control, input, and image rendering without a full screen context. Constructor calls ncdirect_init; destructor calls ncdirect_stop. Copy/move semantics and further invariants are not specified in this header.

C++ widget wrapper around a notcurses ncfdplane. Manages creation and lifetime of an ncfdplane tied to a Plane, reading from a file descriptor and driving callbacks. It owns an underlying ncfdplane* and destroys it in the destructor unless notcurses is stopped. Details of ncfdplane and callback types come from notcurses C API.

C++ RAII wrapper around a notcurses ncmenu. Owns an underlying ncmenu* created in the constructor and destroyed in the destructor unless Notcurses has been stopped. Provides helpers to navigate sections/items, rollup/unroll, set item status, and route input/selection. Requires a NotCurses instance via Root; exposes the associated Plane via get_plane().

C++ widget class wrapping a Notcurses ncmultiselector. Manages creation via ncmultiselector_create in common_init and destruction in the destructor if Notcurses is still running. Provides input offering and selection retrieval APIs. Owns an underlying ncmultiselector* and takes ownership of the provided Plane. Details of Widget, Plane, and other utilities are external. Construction requires a valid Plane (pointer or reference) and optional ncmultiselector_options; throws on invalid plane or creation failure.

Strongly-typed C++ scoped enum (ncpp::NCAlign) representing horizontal text alignment options. Values map directly to the underlying notcurses C macros NCALIGN_LEFT, NCALIGN_CENTER, and NCALIGN_RIGHT. Intended for use within the ncpp namespace to provide type-safe alignment selection. Underlying integral type is implementation-defined; it mirrors the constants from <notcurses/notcurses.h>.

Lightweight namespaced struct containing static constexpr constants that mirror notcurses NCBOX* masks, gradients, and corner values. It has no data members or constructors and serves as a compile-time constants holder for box-drawing configuration in the ncpp namespace. No lifecycle management is required.

Keycode namespace-like utility struct for notcurses input. It exposes notcurses NCKEY_* constants as char32_t constexprs and provides predicate helpers to test for mouse events and Supplementary Private Use Areas. It has no instance data; use its static members. Construction/destruction are irrelevant; treat as a static utility type.
Static-only wrapper exposing notcurses ncintype_e event type constants (press/repeat/release/unknown). No instance data; used as a namespaced collection of constants.

A C++ namespaced struct used as a static container of notcurses log level constants. It defines constexpr aliases of the external ncloglevel_e enumeration values from notcurses (e.g., NCLOGLEVEL_INFO). The struct has no data members or constructors and is intended for namespaced, structured access to logging levels (e.g., ncpp::NCLogLevel::Info). Details about ncloglevel_e itself are external to this header.

objects.definition: class NotCurses;
objects.description: Forward declaration of the ncpp::NotCurses class. Only referenced as a pointer in this header; its definition is not provided here, so details are unknown.

RAII wrapper over a notcurses palette handle. Owns an underlying ncpalette* allocated via ncpalette_new(get_notcurses()) and freed in the destructor with ncpalette_free(). Provides conversion operators to ncpalette* and const ncpalette* and convenience methods to set and get palette entries (either via RGB components or a packed value). Construction may throw init_error on allocation failure. NOEXCEPT_MAYBE and error_guard behavior are defined elsewhere.

Wrapper class in namespace ncpp representing a Notcurses "pile" (a stack of planes) as a specialized Plane. It constructs an ncplane pile via ncpile_create and provides rendering helpers (render, rasterize, show) and utilities to obtain the top/bottom Plane within the same pile. Ownership and lifetime of the underlying ncplane are managed by the Plane base class. Throws on invalid arguments or creation failure.

Concrete plot widget using unsigned 64-bit y-coordinates over an underlying ncuplot. Provides several constructors from Plane and a static default ncplot_options used when opts is null. Exposes access to the associated Plane via get_plane.

Concrete plot widget using double y-coordinates over an underlying ncdplot. Provides several constructors from Plane and a static default ncplot_options used when opts is null. Exposes access to the associated Plane via get_plane.

objects.definition: using Plot = PlotU;
objects.description: Type alias mapping Plot to PlotU, making the unsigned 64-bit plot the default plot type in the ncpp namespace.

RAII C++ wrapper class around a notcurses ncprogbar. It owns an underlying ncprogbar* created in the constructor and destroyed in the destructor (unless notcurses has been stopped). Provides progress manipulation and access to the associated Plane. Inherits from Root (defined elsewhere).

RAII C++ wrapper widget around a notcurses ncreader. Owns an underlying ncreader* tied to a Plane; provides movement, editing, content retrieval, and clearing operations, and destroys the ncreader on scope exit unless notcurses is stopped. Construction requires a Plane and ncreader_options; ownership of the Plane is taken via Widget helpers.

C++ wrapper widget around a Notcurses ncreel. Manages the lifecycle of an underlying ncreel*, provides tablet add/delete/navigation, redraw, and input offering. Owns or references a Plane for rendering. Destroys the ncreel in the destructor unless Notcurses is already stopped. Details like exception types and some helpers are defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: class NotCurses;
objects.description: Forward declaration of the NotCurses class within the ncpp namespace. Its definition is not present in this header; it represents the main C++ wrapper around a notcurses context. Details unknown here.

Base utility class for notcurses++ wrappers. Holds a pointer to the owning NotCurses instance and provides helpers: accessors to the C notcurses handle and C++ NotCurses wrapper, error-guard templates to normalize error handling with optional exceptions, and a safety check to know if NotCurses has been stopped to avoid destruction-time crashes. Construction requires an existing NotCurses*. Specific lifetime and ownership of nc are not defined here; Root does not own nc.

C++ widget class wrapping a Notcurses ncselector. It manages the lifetime of the underlying ncselector*, provides item management (add/delete), navigation (prev/next), selection query, and input offering. Constructed on an existing Plane; takes ownership of that Plane via the base Widget. Destructor destroys the ncselector unless Notcurses has been stopped. Details of Widget, Plane, and helper utilities are external to this header.

C++ widget class that manages a notcurses ncsubproc instance tied to a Plane. Provides constructors to spawn a subprocess (optionally using PATH and environment), owns the underlying ncsubproc*, destroys it in the destructor, and exposes the associated Plane via get_plane(). Details of behavior depend on notcurses; default_options is declared but defined elsewhere.

C++ wrapper class around a notcurses nctablet handle. It stores and exposes the underlying nctablet*, provides typed access to the tablet user pointer, implicit conversions to nctablet*/const nctablet*, and helpers to map/unmap C handles to NcTablet instances. It derives from Root, requires a non-null nctablet* in its constructor, and offers retrieval of the associated Plane. Details of construction and lifetime beyond the stored pointer are not fully specified here.
Forward declaration of a Plane class in namespace ncpp. No definition is provided in this header; only the type name is introduced for use as a pointer/reference in NcTablet APIs.
Forward declaration of a NotCurses class in namespace ncpp. No definition is provided in this header; referenced as a parameter/association for NcTablet construction and mapping.
Friend class forward declaration in namespace ncpp. No definition in this header; listed as a friend of NcTablet.
Opaque C handle type from notcurses referenced by this header but not defined here. Included via <notcurses/notcurses.h>; this header does not define it.

Utility class in namespace ncpp exposing static helpers to bridge C++ wrapper types (Plane, Root) to the underlying notcurses C API. Provides conversion from ncpp::Plane to ncplane* and retrieval of the owning ncpp::NotCurses instance from Root or Plane. Details of internal storage/ownership are not present in this header.

objects.definition: class NotCurses;
objects.description: Forward declaration of the ncpp C++ wrapper around the notcurses context. Only declared here; no definition provided in this header.

objects.definition: class Plane;
objects.description: Forward declaration of a C++ wrapper around a notcurses plane. Only declared here; no definition provided in this header.

objects.definition: class Root;
objects.description: Forward declaration of a base/root object in the ncpp hierarchy, likely associated with NotCurses lifetime. Only declared here; no definition provided in this header.

C++ RAII wrapper for a notcurses ncvisual. Manages the lifetime of an underlying ncvisual*, providing construction from file, RGBA memory, or a Plane region, plus decode/blit/stream/geometry/pixel operations. Destroys the ncvisual unless Notcurses has been stopped.
direct_api_constructors: ncpp::Visual::Visual(const ncpp::Plane&, ncblitter_e, unsigned, unsigned, unsigned, unsigned)

objects.description: Concrete base widget class in namespace ncpp, exported with NCPP_API_EXPORT, deriving from Root. It provides protected utilities for validating a Plane and taking ownership of a Plane by releasing its native handle. Construction is protected and requires a NotCurses* passed to the Root base. No public API is exposed here; intended to be subclassed by concrete widgets.

Exception class signaling initialization failures within the ncpp library. Derives from std::logic_error and accepts a message via std::string or const char*. No additional state or behavior beyond standard exception semantics is defined in this header.
Exception class indicating that an operation was attempted in an invalid or inappropriate state. Inherits from std::logic_error; constructors forward the diagnostic message.
Exception class for invalid argument errors specific to ncpp. It derives from std::invalid_argument and carries only the message string.
Exception class representing an invalid or failed API call in ncpp. Subclass of std::logic_error; holds only the explanatory message.

functions.name: notcurses_version
functions.signature: const char* notcurses_version(void)
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the running Notcurses version. Intended to reflect the version of the loaded library, not just compile-time headers.

functions.name: notcurses_version_components
functions.signature: void notcurses_version_components(int* major, int* minor, int* patch, int* tweak)
functions.description: Writes the version components of the running Notcurses library into the provided pointers.
requirements: major must be a valid pointer if non-NULL.
minor must be a valid pointer if non-NULL.
patch must be a valid pointer if non-NULL.
tweak must be a valid pointer if non-NULL.

functions.name: ncstrwidth
functions.signature: int ncstrwidth(const char* egcs, int* validbytes, int* validwidth)
functions.description: Returns the number of column cells the longest valid prefix of a UTF-8 string occupies. On encountering an invalid character, returns -1 and writes bytes/columns of the valid prefix to validbytes/validwidth (if non-NULL).
requirements: egcs must be non-NULL.
If validbytes is non-NULL, it must be a valid pointer to int.
If validwidth is non-NULL, it must be a valid pointer to int.

functions.name: notcurses_ucs32_to_utf8
functions.signature: int notcurses_ucs32_to_utf8(const uint32_t* ucs32, unsigned ucs32count, unsigned char* resultbuf, size_t buflen)
functions.description: Converts an array of UCS-32 codepoints to UTF-8. Returns bytes written, or -1 on illegal codepoint or insufficient buffer.
requirements: ucs32 must be non-NULL.
resultbuf must be non-NULL.
buflen must be sufficient for up to 4 bytes per codepoint (6 if future-proofing).
ucs32count is the number of input codepoints.

functions.name: nccell_load
functions.signature: int nccell_load(struct ncplane* n, nccell* c, const char* gcluster)
functions.description: Parses a UTF-8 EGC string into a cell on the given plane. Returns bytes consumed or -1 on failure. Leaves style unchanged; releases any prior resources in c.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid nccell pointer initialized or ready to be overwritten.
gcluster must be a valid UTF-8 string (NUL-terminated).

functions.name: nccell_duplicate
functions.signature: int nccell_duplicate(struct ncplane* n, nccell* targ, const nccell* c)
functions.description: Duplicates a cell into targ on the same plane n. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane and both cells must be/will be bound to n.
targ must be a valid nccell pointer to receive the duplicate.
c must be a valid initialized nccell from plane n.

functions.name: nccell_release
functions.signature: void nccell_release(struct ncplane* n, nccell* c)
functions.description: Releases any resources associated with the cell c on plane n. After release, the cell contents are invalid.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid nccell pointer associated with n.

functions.name: nccell_extended_gcluster
functions.signature: const char* nccell_extended_gcluster(const struct ncplane* n, const nccell* c)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the NUL-terminated EGC string for the given cell on plane n. Pointer may be invalidated by subsequent operations on the plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid nccell.
Caller must not use the returned pointer after mutating the plane.

functions.name: notcurses_lex_margins
functions.signature: int notcurses_lex_margins(const char* op, notcurses_options* opts)
functions.description: Parses a margin specification string (one number for all sides or four comma-separated numbers) and fills in opts->margin_* accordingly.
requirements: op must be non-NULL and contain a valid margin specification.
opts must be a valid pointer to notcurses_options.

functions.name: notcurses_lex_blitter
functions.signature: int notcurses_lex_blitter(const char* op, ncblitter_e* blitter)
functions.description: Parses a blitter name string into an ncblitter_e value.
requirements: op must be non-NULL.
blitter must be a valid pointer to receive the parsed value.

functions.name: notcurses_str_blitter
functions.signature: const char* notcurses_str_blitter(ncblitter_e blitter)
functions.description: Returns the string name of a given blitter enum value.

functions.name: notcurses_lex_scalemode
functions.signature: int notcurses_lex_scalemode(const char* op, ncscale_e* scalemode)
functions.description: Parses a scaling mode string ("none", "stretch", "scale", "hires", "scalehi", or "inflate") into an ncscale_e value.
requirements: op must be non-NULL.
scalemode must be a valid pointer to receive the parsed value.

functions.name: notcurses_str_scalemode
functions.signature: const char* notcurses_str_scalemode(ncscale_e scalemode)
functions.description: Returns the string name of a scaling mode.

functions.name: notcurses_init
functions.signature: struct notcurses* notcurses_init(const notcurses_options* opts, FILE* fp)
functions.description: Initializes a Notcurses rendering context on a connected terminal. If fp is NULL, opens /dev/tty. Returns context or NULL on failure.
requirements: fp must refer to a TTY if non-NULL.
opts may be NULL or a valid notcurses_options; undefined flag bits must be 0.
Environment/terminfo must be available; failure to initialize terminfo causes failure.

functions.name: notcurses_core_init
functions.signature: struct notcurses* notcurses_core_init(const notcurses_options* opts, FILE* fp)
functions.description: Initializes a Notcurses context without multimedia functionality (link with notcurses-core). Returns context or NULL on failure.
requirements: Same requirements as notcurses_init regarding fp and opts.

functions.name: notcurses_stop
functions.signature: int notcurses_stop(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Destroys a Notcurses context, restoring terminal state. NULL is a no-op.
requirements: nc may be NULL or a valid notcurses context.
Should be called once per successful initialization.

functions.name: notcurses_enter_alternate_screen
functions.signature: int notcurses_enter_alternate_screen(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Switches to the terminal’s alternate screen if available; returns 0 on success, -1 if not available.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.
Calling when already in alternate screen just returns 0.

functions.name: notcurses_leave_alternate_screen
functions.signature: int notcurses_leave_alternate_screen(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Leaves the terminal’s alternate screen if currently using it; returns 0 otherwise.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: notcurses_stdplane
functions.signature: struct ncplane* notcurses_stdplane(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Returns the standard plane associated with the Notcurses context. Always exists and spans terminal size.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: notcurses_stdplane_const
functions.signature: const struct ncplane* notcurses_stdplane_const(const struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Const-qualified accessor to the standard plane.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncpile_top
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncpile_top(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Returns the topmost plane of the pile containing the given plane.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncpile_bottom
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncpile_bottom(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Returns the bottommost plane of the pile containing the given plane.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncpile_render
functions.signature: int ncpile_render(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Renders the pile containing plane n into an internal buffer. Must be followed by rasterize to display.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Rendering again before rasterize overwrites previous render.

functions.name: ncpile_rasterize
functions.signature: int ncpile_rasterize(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Writes the last rendered frame of the pile containing n to the terminal (blocking).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Must be called after a successful render to display content.

functions.name: ncpile_render_to_buffer
functions.signature: int ncpile_render_to_buffer(struct ncplane* p, char** buf, size_t* buflen)
functions.description: Renders and rasterizes the pile of p but does not write to the terminal; returns a buffer and size which caller must free.
requirements: p must be non-NULL and valid.
buf must be a non-NULL pointer to receive allocated buffer.
buflen must be a non-NULL pointer to receive length.
Caller must free the returned *buf.

functions.name: ncpile_render_to_file
functions.signature: int ncpile_render_to_file(struct ncplane* p, FILE* fp)
functions.description: Writes the last rendered frame of the pile containing p to the given FILE stream.
requirements: p must be non-NULL and valid.
fp must be non-NULL and writable.
A frame must have been rendered previously, otherwise nothing is written.

functions.name: notcurses_drop_planes
functions.signature: void notcurses_drop_planes(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Destroys all planes other than the standard plane for the given Notcurses context.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: notcurses_get
functions.signature: uint32_t notcurses_get(struct notcurses* n, const struct timespec* ts, ncinput* ni)
functions.description: Reads a single UTF-32 codepoint or synthesized special key. Blocks until input or signal if ts is NULL; returns 0 on timeout, (uint32_t)-1 on error/EOF.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
ts may be NULL (blocking) or an absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC deadline.
ni may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive event details.

functions.name: notcurses_getvec
functions.signature: int notcurses_getvec(struct notcurses* n, const struct timespec* ts, ncinput* ni, int vcount)
functions.description: Reads up to vcount input events into ni. Returns number read, 0 on timeout, -1 on error (no reads).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
ni must be non-NULL and point to an array of at least vcount ncinput.
vcount must be > 0 for useful reads.
ts may be NULL for blocking or an absolute deadline.

functions.name: notcurses_inputready_fd
functions.signature: int notcurses_inputready_fd(struct notcurses* n)
functions.description: Returns a file descriptor suitable for poll/select indicating when input is ready for notcurses_get_nblock().
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Caller must not assume it is the same as stdin’s fd.

functions.name: notcurses_mice_enable
functions.signature: int notcurses_mice_enable(struct notcurses* n, unsigned eventmask)
functions.description: Enables mouse event tracking according to eventmask (bitmask of NCMICE_*). Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
eventmask can be NCMICE_NO_EVENTS to disable.

functions.name: notcurses_linesigs_disable
functions.signature: int notcurses_linesigs_disable(struct notcurses* n)
functions.description: Disables terminal line discipline signals (SIGINT, SIGQUIT, SIGTSTP).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: notcurses_linesigs_enable
functions.signature: int notcurses_linesigs_enable(struct notcurses* n)
functions.description: Enables terminal line discipline signals if previously disabled.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: notcurses_refresh
functions.signature: int notcurses_refresh(struct notcurses* n, unsigned* y, unsigned* x)
functions.description: Refreshes the physical screen to the last rendered frame without re-rendering. Useful after external corruption or resize before re-render.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
y and x may be NULL or valid pointers to receive current screen geometry.

functions.name: ncplane_notcurses
functions.signature: struct notcurses* ncplane_notcurses(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Returns the Notcurses context to which the plane belongs.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncplane_notcurses_const
functions.signature: const struct notcurses* ncplane_notcurses_const(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Const-qualified accessor to the Notcurses context of the plane.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncplane_dim_yx
functions.signature: void ncplane_dim_yx(const struct ncplane* n, unsigned* y, unsigned* x)
functions.description: Writes the dimensions (rows, cols) of the plane into y and x (each may be NULL).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
y and/or x, if non-NULL, must be valid pointers.

functions.name: ncplane_pixel_geom
functions.signature: void ncplane_pixel_geom(const struct ncplane* n, unsigned* pxy, unsigned* pxx, unsigned* celldimy, unsigned* celldimx, unsigned* maxbmapy, unsigned* maxbmapx)
functions.description: Retrieves pixel geometry for the display region, cell geometry, and maximum displayable bitmap size for the plane’s pile.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
All output pointers are optional; any non-NULL must be valid pointers.

functions.name: notcurses_at_yx
functions.signature: char* notcurses_at_yx(struct notcurses* nc, unsigned yoff, unsigned xoff, uint16_t* stylemask, uint64_t* channels)
functions.description: Returns a heap-allocated EGC representing the last-rendered contents at stdplane coordinates (yoff,xoff). Writes style and channels if provided.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.
yoff/xoff must be within the standard plane bounds.
Caller must free the returned string if non-NULL.
stylemask and channels, if non-NULL, must be valid pointers.

functions.name: ncplane_create
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncplane_create(struct ncplane* n, const ncplane_options* nopts)
functions.description: Creates a new plane bound to parent plane n using options nopts. Starts at top of z-buffer.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid parent plane.
nopts must be non-NULL and specify positive rows/cols unless marginalized.
Flags must be consistent (e.g., alignment flags are exclusive with marginalized).

functions.name: ncpile_create
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncpile_create(struct notcurses* nc, const ncplane_options* nopts)
functions.description: Creates a new root plane in a new pile according to options. Returned plane is top/bottom/root of the new pile.
requirements: nc must be non-NULL and valid.
nopts must be non-NULL and valid as in ncplane_create.

functions.name: ncplane_resize_maximize
functions.signature: int ncplane_resize_maximize(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Utility resize callback: resizes plane to the visual region’s size (used for standard plane).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid plane.

functions.name: ncplane_resize_marginalized
functions.signature: int ncplane_resize_marginalized(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Utility resize callback: resizes plane to parent size honoring NCPLANE_OPTION_MARGINALIZED margins.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid plane.
Plane should have marginalized options set for meaningful effect.

functions.name: ncplane_resize_realign
functions.signature: int ncplane_resize_realign(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Utility resize callback: realigns plane within parent using configured horizontal/vertical align flags.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid plane.

functions.name: ncplane_resize_placewithin
functions.signature: int ncplane_resize_placewithin(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Utility resize callback: moves plane to be entirely within its parent, if possible, without resizing.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid plane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_resizecb
functions.signature: void ncplane_set_resizecb(struct ncplane* n, int (*resizecb)(struct ncplane*))
functions.description: Sets the plane’s resize callback function (may be NULL). The standard plane’s resizecb cannot be changed.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Do not call on the standard plane to change its callback.

functions.name: ncplane_resizecb
functions.signature: int (*ncplane_resizecb(const struct ncplane* n))(struct ncplane*)
functions.description: Returns the current resize callback for the plane.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: ncplane_set_name
functions.signature: int ncplane_set_name(struct ncplane* n, const char* name)
functions.description: Sets or replaces the plane’s name (used for debugging).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
name may be NULL or a valid UTF-8 string.

functions.name: ncplane_name
functions.signature: char* ncplane_name(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Returns a heap-allocated copy of the plane’s name, or NULL if none.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Caller must free the returned string if non-NULL.

functions.name: ncplane_reparent
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncplane_reparent(struct ncplane* n, struct ncplane* newparent)
functions.description: Reparents plane n to newparent; if newparent==n and n is not root, n becomes root of a new pile. Bound children of n are reparented to n’s previous parent.
requirements: n and newparent must be non-NULL and valid (standard plane cannot be reparented).
n and newparent must not be the same unless creating a new pile; behavior depends on current root status.

functions.name: ncplane_reparent_family
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncplane_reparent_family(struct ncplane* n, struct ncplane* newparent)
functions.description: Reparents n along with its bound descendants to newparent, maintaining internal z-order. Fails (returns NULL) if newparent is an ancestor of n.
requirements: n and newparent must be non-NULL and valid.
newparent must not be an ancestor of n.
Standard plane cannot be reparented.

functions.name: ncplane_dup
functions.signature: struct ncplane* ncplane_dup(const struct ncplane* n, void* opaque)
functions.description: Duplicates a plane’s geometry and content to a new plane directly above the original, bound to the same parent (or bound to the root if n is a root).
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
Bound child planes are not duplicated.

functions.name: ncplane_translate
functions.signature: void ncplane_translate(const struct ncplane* src, const struct ncplane* dst, int* y, int* x)
functions.description: Maps coordinates relative to src into coordinates relative to dst (or stdplane if dst is NULL). y/x may be NULL.
requirements: src must be non-NULL and valid.
y and/or x, if non-NULL, must point to integers to be transformed.

functions.name: ncplane_translate_abs
functions.signature: bool ncplane_translate_abs(const struct ncplane* n, int* y, int* x)
functions.description: Translates absolute coordinates into coordinates relative to plane n, returning whether the point lies within n.
requirements: n must be non-NULL and valid.
y and/or x must be non-NULL pointers to absolute coordinates to be converted.

functions.name: ncplane_set_scrolling
functions.signature: API bool ncplane_set_scrolling(struct ncplane* n, unsigned scrollp)
functions.description: Enable or disable vertical scrolling on a plane. Returns previous state (true if it had been enabled, false otherwise).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane pointer (non-NULL).

functions.name: ncplane_scrolling_p
functions.signature: API bool ncplane_scrolling_p(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Query whether vertical scrolling is currently enabled on a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane pointer (non-NULL).

functions.name: ncplane_set_autogrow
functions.signature: API bool ncplane_set_autogrow(struct ncplane* n, unsigned growp)
functions.description: Enable or disable automatic growth of a plane to accommodate output. Returns previous autogrow state.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane pointer (non-NULL).

functions.name: ncplane_autogrow_p
functions.signature: API bool ncplane_autogrow_p(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Query whether autogrow is enabled for a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane pointer (non-NULL).

functions.name: ncpalette_new
functions.signature: API ALLOC ncpalette* ncpalette_new(struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Allocate and return a new palette store initialized to the terminal’s current palette knowledge.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Caller owns the returned pointer and must free it with ncpalette_free().

functions.name: ncpalette_use
functions.signature: API int ncpalette_use(struct notcurses* nc, const ncpalette* p)
functions.description: Attempt to configure the terminal’s hardware palette from the provided palette store. Does not take ownership of p.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
p must be a valid palette pointer (non-NULL).
Terminal must support changing colors (ccc) and have sufficient palette entries; otherwise the call may fail.

functions.name: ncpalette_free
functions.signature: API void ncpalette_free(ncpalette* p)
functions.description: Free a palette store previously allocated by ncpalette_new().
requirements: p may be NULL (no-op) or a valid palette pointer obtained from ncpalette_new().
Do not use p after freeing.

functions.name: notcurses_supported_styles
functions.signature: API uint16_t notcurses_supported_styles(const struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Return a bitmask of curses-style attributes supported by the terminal together with color (per terminfo ncv capability).
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Pure function with respect to nc state.

functions.name: notcurses_palette_size
functions.signature: API unsigned notcurses_palette_size(const struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Return the number of simultaneous colors the terminal claims to support, or 1 if none.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Pure function with respect to nc state.

functions.name: notcurses_detected_terminal
functions.signature: ALLOC API char* notcurses_detected_terminal(const struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Return a heap-allocated string naming the detected terminal (and sometimes version).
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: notcurses_capabilities
functions.signature: API const nccapabilities* notcurses_capabilities(const struct notcurses* n)
functions.description: Return a pointer to the capabilities struct describing terminal features (UTF-8, RGB, palette size, and glyph set support).
requirements: n must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
The returned pointer remains valid as long as the notcurses context is alive; do not free.

functions.name: notcurses_check_pixel_support
functions.signature: API ncpixelimpl_e notcurses_check_pixel_support(const struct notcurses* nc)
functions.description: Report the terminal’s pixel-graphics implementation capability (e.g., SIXEL, KITTY, etc.), or NCPIXEL_NONE.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Pure query; does not modify state.

functions.name: notcurses_stats_alloc
functions.signature: API ALLOC ncstats* notcurses_stats_alloc(const struct notcurses* nc __attribute__ ((unused)))
functions.description: Allocate an ncstats structure sized for this notcurses version. Use this instead of stack-allocating to remain forward-compatible.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
Caller must free the returned pointer with free().

functions.name: notcurses_stats
functions.signature: API void notcurses_stats(struct notcurses* nc, ncstats* stats)
functions.description: Acquire an atomic snapshot of statistics from the notcurses object and write them into stats.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
stats must be a valid pointer to writable ncstats storage (non-NULL).

functions.name: notcurses_stats_reset
functions.signature: API void notcurses_stats_reset(struct notcurses* nc, ncstats* stats)
functions.description: Reset cumulative stats in the notcurses context after copying them to stats (if non-NULL). Immediate metrics are not reset.
requirements: nc must be a valid notcurses context (non-NULL).
stats may be NULL or a valid pointer to writable ncstats storage.

functions.name: ncplane_resize
functions.signature: API int ncplane_resize(struct ncplane* n, int keepy, int keepx, unsigned keepleny, unsigned keeplenx, int yoff, int xoff, unsigned ylen, unsigned xlen)
functions.description: Resize a plane, preserving a specified kept subregion and placing it at a specified offset within the new geometry.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane and not the standard plane (resizing stdplane is an error).
keepy, keepx >= 0; they must identify a coordinate within the plane.
keepleny and keeplenx define the kept region size; if either is non-zero, both must be non-zero; they must be within original plane bounds.
yoff and xoff position the kept region’s upper-left within the resized plane; resulting kept region must fit within new ylen/xlen.
ylen >= keepleny and xlen >= keeplenx.
On error the plane is unchanged.

functions.name: ncplane_destroy
functions.signature: API int ncplane_destroy(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Destroy a plane. Its contents become invisible on the next render. Destroying the standard plane is an error. NULL is a no-op.
requirements: n must not be the standard plane.
n may be NULL (no-op).
After destruction, n must not be used.

functions.name: ncplane_set_base_cell
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_base_cell(struct ncplane* n, const nccell* c)
functions.description: Set the plane’s base cell. The base cell is used where plane cells have no glyph (gcluster==0). Not affected by ncplane_erase().
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid nccell and not a secondary cell of a wide EGC.

functions.name: ncplane_set_base
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_base(struct ncplane* n, const char* egc, uint16_t stylemask, uint64_t channels)
functions.description: Set the plane’s base cell by EGC, style, and channels. Returns number of bytes consumed from egc or -1 on failure.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
egc must point to a valid UTF-8 extended grapheme cluster.
stylemask uses NCSTYLE_* bits (lower 16 bits).
channels must be a valid channels spec.

functions.name: ncplane_base
functions.signature: API int ncplane_base(struct ncplane* n, nccell* c)
functions.description: Extract the plane’s base cell into c. The reference becomes invalid if the plane is destroyed.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid pointer to nccell storage.

functions.name: ncplane_yx
functions.signature: API void ncplane_yx(const struct ncplane* n, int* RESTRICT y, int* RESTRICT x)
functions.description: Get the plane’s origin relative to its bound parent (or pile root if it’s a root plane).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and/or x may be NULL; non-NULL must be writable.

functions.name: ncplane_y
functions.signature: API int ncplane_y(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane’s y origin relative to its bound parent/pile.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_x
functions.signature: API int ncplane_x(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane’s x origin relative to its bound parent/pile.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_move_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_move_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x)
functions.description: Move the plane to absolute coordinates relative to its bound reference (stdplane or parent). Moving the standard plane is an error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane and not the standard plane.
Target position must be valid within parent/stack constraints; errors otherwise.

functions.name: ncplane_abs_yx
functions.signature: API void ncplane_abs_yx(const struct ncplane* n, int* RESTRICT y, int* RESTRICT x)
functions.description: Get the plane’s origin in absolute pile coordinates.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and/or x may be NULL; non-NULL must be writable.

functions.name: ncplane_abs_y
functions.signature: API int ncplane_abs_y(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane’s absolute y origin in its pile.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_abs_x
functions.signature: API int ncplane_abs_x(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane’s absolute x origin in its pile.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_parent
functions.signature: API struct ncplane* ncplane_parent(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane to which n is bound, if any (mutable pointer).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_parent_const
functions.signature: API const struct ncplane* ncplane_parent_const(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane to which n is bound, if any (const pointer).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_move_above
functions.signature: API int ncplane_move_above(struct ncplane* RESTRICT n, struct ncplane* RESTRICT above)
functions.description: Reposition n in the z-buffer directly above the given plane. If above is NULL, move n to the bottom. Returns non-zero if already there.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane and non-NULL.
above may be NULL or a different plane in the same pile; n and above must not be the same.

functions.name: ncplane_move_below
functions.signature: API int ncplane_move_below(struct ncplane* RESTRICT n, struct ncplane* RESTRICT below)
functions.description: Reposition n in the z-buffer directly below the given plane. If below is NULL, move n to the top. Returns non-zero if already there.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane and non-NULL.
below may be NULL or a different plane in the same pile; n and below must not be the same.

functions.name: ncplane_move_family_above
functions.signature: API int ncplane_move_family_above(struct ncplane* n, struct ncplane* targ)
functions.description: Move a plane and all of its bound descendants in the z-buffer above targ, preserving relative order.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
targ may be NULL (moves family to bottom) or a valid plane in same pile.
All planes in family must belong to same pile as targ.

functions.name: ncplane_move_family_below
functions.signature: API int ncplane_move_family_below(struct ncplane* n, struct ncplane* targ)
functions.description: Move a plane and all of its bound descendants in the z-buffer below targ, preserving relative order.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
targ may be NULL (moves family to top) or a valid plane in same pile.
All planes in family must belong to same pile as targ.

functions.name: ncplane_family_destroy
functions.signature: API int ncplane_family_destroy(struct ncplane *n)
functions.description: Destroy a plane and all of its bound descendants. NULL is a no-op. Destroying the standard plane is an error.
requirements: n may be NULL (no-op) or a valid plane that is not the standard plane.
After destruction, involved planes must not be used.

functions.name: ncplane_below
functions.signature: API struct ncplane* ncplane_below(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane immediately below n in its pile, or NULL if n is at the bottom.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_above
functions.signature: API struct ncplane* ncplane_above(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane immediately above n in its pile, or NULL if n is at the top.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_scrollup
functions.signature: API int ncplane_scrollup(struct ncplane* n, int r)
functions.description: Scroll a scrolling-enabled plane up by r lines. Returns error if plane is not scrolling; otherwise returns number of lines scrolled.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane with scrolling enabled (see ncplane_set_scrolling()).
r specifies number of scroll events; may be positive; header does not restrict sign but semantics imply positive.

functions.name: ncplane_scrollup_child
functions.signature: API int ncplane_scrollup_child(struct ncplane* n, const struct ncplane* child)
functions.description: Scroll n up until child is no longer hidden beneath it. Errors if child is not a child, n is not scrolling, or child is fixed. Returns number of scroll events performed.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane with scrolling enabled.
child must be a valid ncplane that is a child of n.
If child is fixed, the call errors.

functions.name: ncplane_rotate_cw
functions.signature: API int ncplane_rotate_cw(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Rotate the plane’s contents 90 degrees clockwise. Only safe for rotatable glyph subsets (line-drawing, spaces, half/full blocks). Plane must have an even number of columns.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Only supported glyphs may be present; others will cause failure.
Plane must have an even number of columns.

functions.name: ncplane_rotate_ccw
functions.signature: API int ncplane_rotate_ccw(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Rotate the plane’s contents 90 degrees counterclockwise. Same limitations as ncplane_rotate_cw().
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Only supported glyphs may be present; others will cause failure.
Plane must have an even number of columns.

functions.name: ncplane_at_cursor
functions.signature: API char* ncplane_at_cursor(const struct ncplane* n, uint16_t* stylemask, uint64_t* channels)
functions.description: Return a heap-allocated EGC for the cell under the cursor; also write stylemask and channels if provided. Caller must free the string.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Caller must free the returned string.
stylemask and channels may be NULL or valid writable pointers.

functions.name: ncplane_at_cursor_cell
functions.signature: API int ncplane_at_cursor_cell(struct ncplane* n, nccell* c)
functions.description: Retrieve the current cell under the cursor into c. Returns EGC byte count or -1 on error. c is invalidated if plane is destroyed.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid pointer to an nccell to receive contents.

functions.name: ncplane_at_yx
functions.signature: API char* ncplane_at_yx(const struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, uint16_t* stylemask, uint64_t* channels)
functions.description: Return a heap-allocated EGC for the specified cell coordinates, or NULL on error. Writes stylemask and channels when non-NULL. Integrates base cell where appropriate; for sprixel planes returns control sequence.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and x must reference a valid cell within the plane.
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: ncplane_at_yx_cell
functions.signature: API int ncplane_at_yx_cell(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, nccell* c)
functions.description: Retrieve the specified cell’s contents into c. Returns EGC byte count or -1 on error. Distinguishes secondary columns of wide glyphs. Error to call on sprixel planes.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane (not a sprixel plane).
y and x must reference a valid cell within the plane.
c must be a valid pointer to an nccell.

functions.name: ncplane_contents
functions.signature: API char* ncplane_contents(struct ncplane* n, int begy, int begx, unsigned leny, unsigned lenx)
functions.description: Create a flat string from EGCs over a selected region of a plane. Returns heap-allocated string the caller must free.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
begy/begx must be on-plane (or -1 to use cursor in that axis).
leny/lenx of 0 mean to the boundary; otherwise must be within bounds.
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: ncplane_set_userptr
functions.signature: API void* ncplane_set_userptr(struct ncplane* n, void* opaque)
functions.description: Replace the plane’s opaque user pointer with opaque and return the previous value.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_userptr
functions.signature: API void* ncplane_userptr(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Return the plane’s current opaque user pointer.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_center_abs
functions.signature: API void ncplane_center_abs(const struct ncplane* n, int* RESTRICT y, int* RESTRICT x)
functions.description: Compute the absolute center coordinate of a plane, biased top/left on even sizes, and return via y/x (modified relative to origin).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and/or x may be NULL; non-NULL must be writable.

functions.name: ncplane_as_rgba
functions.signature: API ALLOC uint32_t* ncplane_as_rgba(const struct ncplane* n, ncblitter_e blit, int begy, int begx, unsigned leny, unsigned lenx, unsigned* pxdimy, unsigned* pxdimx)
functions.description: Export a selected region of a plane as a flat RGBA pixel array (ABGR in host-endian word order per ncpixel helpers). Only glyphs from the specified blitter set may be present. Returns heap-allocated pixel buffer.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
blit must be a plot/visual-eligible blitter; only glyphs from that set may be present in the region.
begy/begx must lie on the plane; leny/lenx of 0 mean to the edge.
pxdimy/pxdimx may be NULL or writable to receive pixel geometry.
Caller must free the returned buffer.

functions.name: ncplane_cursor_move_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_cursor_move_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x)
functions.description: Move the plane cursor to y,x. Pass -1 to hold an axis steady. Returns -1 if movement would place the cursor outside the plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Target must be within plane bounds unless using -1 to keep axis.

functions.name: ncplane_cursor_move_rel
functions.signature: API int ncplane_cursor_move_rel(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x)
functions.description: Move the cursor relative to its current position; negative moves up/left. Returns -1 if target exceeds plane dimensions.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_home
functions.signature: API void ncplane_home(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Home the cursor to 0,0 on the plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_cursor_yx
functions.signature: API void ncplane_cursor_yx(const struct ncplane* n, unsigned* RESTRICT y, unsigned* RESTRICT x)
functions.description: Get the current cursor position within a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and/or x may be NULL; non-NULL must be writable.

functions.name: ncplane_channels
functions.signature: API uint64_t ncplane_channels(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Get the current working channels (foreground/background color+alpha) for a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_styles
functions.signature: API uint16_t ncplane_styles(const struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Get the current stylemask (NCSTYLE_* bits) for a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_putc_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putc_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, const nccell* c)
functions.description: Write the provided cell at y,x (or -1 to use current axis), advance cursor by cell width but not past end. Returns columns advanced; -1 on error. c must be associated with n.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid nccell already associated with n.
Target coordinates must be in-bounds or -1 to use current.

functions.name: ncplane_putchar_stained
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putchar_stained(struct ncplane* n, char c)
functions.description: Replace the underlying EGC at the cursor with the provided 7-bit char, retaining existing style. Returns columns advanced or -1 on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_putegc_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putegc_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, const char* gclust, size_t* sbytes)
functions.description: Write a UTF-8 EGC at y,x (or -1 for current axis), advance cursor by cluster width. Returns columns advanced, -1 on error; writes bytes consumed to sbytes if non-NULL.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
gclust must point to a valid UTF-8 EGC.
Target coordinates must be in-bounds or -1 to use current.

functions.name: ncplane_putegc_stained
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putegc_stained(struct ncplane* n, const char* gclust, size_t* sbytes)
functions.description: Replace the EGC at the cursor with the provided EGC, retaining existing styling. Returns columns advanced, -1 on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
gclust must be a valid UTF-8 EGC.

functions.name: ncplane_putnstr_aligned
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putnstr_aligned(struct ncplane* n, int y, ncalign_e align, size_t s, const char* str)
functions.description: Write up to s bytes from str as EGCs starting at aligned column in row y. Returns columns written; negative on partial-write error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
str must be a valid UTF-8 buffer; s limits bytes consumed.
align must be a valid ncalign_e; y is target row.

functions.name: ncplane_putwstr_stained
functions.signature: API int ncplane_putwstr_stained(struct ncplane* n, const wchar_t* gclustarr)
functions.description: Write a series of wide EGCs at the current cursor location, retaining existing styling. Returns columns written; negative indicates partial write before error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
gclustarr must be a NUL-terminated wide string.

functions.name: ncplane_vprintf_aligned
functions.signature: API int ncplane_vprintf_aligned(struct ncplane* n, int y, ncalign_e align, const char* format, va_list ap)
functions.description: Formatted print aligned on row y according to align, using current plane style. Returns columns advanced; negative indicates partial-write error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
format must be a valid printf-style format; ap must be a valid va_list.

functions.name: ncplane_vprintf_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_vprintf_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, const char* format, va_list ap)
functions.description: Formatted print at y,x (or -1 to keep an axis), using current plane style. Returns columns advanced; negative indicates partial-write error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
format must be valid; ap must be a valid va_list.
Target coordinates in-bounds or -1 to use current.

functions.name: ncplane_vprintf_stained
functions.signature: API int ncplane_vprintf_stained(struct ncplane* n, const char* format, va_list ap)
functions.description: Formatted print at current cursor, retaining styling at destination cells. Returns columns advanced; negative indicates partial-write error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
format must be valid; ap must be a valid va_list.

functions.name: ncplane_puttext
functions.signature: API int ncplane_puttext(struct ncplane* n, int y, ncalign_e align, const char* text, size_t* bytes)
functions.description: Write multi-line text with sensible line breaks starting at row y, aligned per align. Clears to end of each broken line (except the last). Returns columns written; writes number of bytes consumed to bytes.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
text must be a valid UTF-8 string.
y may be -1 to start relative to current cursor row for first line; alignment applies per documentation.

functions.name: ncplane_hline_interp
functions.signature: API int ncplane_hline_interp(struct ncplane* n, const nccell* c, unsigned len, uint64_t c1, uint64_t c2)
functions.description: Draw a horizontal line of length len using cell c, interpolating channels from c1 to c2 across the line. Returns cells drawn or negative on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid initialized nccell.
len must be > 0.
c1 and c2 are channels; palette-indexed/RGB rules apply as with general rendering.

functions.name: ncplane_vline_interp
functions.signature: API int ncplane_vline_interp(struct ncplane* n, const nccell* c, unsigned len, uint64_t c1, uint64_t c2)
functions.description: Draw a vertical line of length len using cell c, interpolating channels from c1 to c2. Returns cells drawn or negative on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
c must be a valid initialized nccell.
len must be > 0.

functions.name: ncplane_box
functions.signature: API int ncplane_box(struct ncplane* n, const nccell* ul, const nccell* ur, const nccell* ll, const nccell* lr, const nccell* hline, const nccell* vline, unsigned ystop, unsigned xstop, unsigned ctlword)
functions.description: Draw a box from the cursor’s current position to ystop,xstop using provided corner/edge cells and control word for edges/gradients/corner draw rules.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
ul/ur/ll/lr/hline/vline must be initialized nccells with appropriate glyphs.
ystop/xstop must define a box fully on-plane.
ctlword’s masks must be set per NCBOX* definitions.

functions.name: ncplane_polyfill_yx
functions.signature: API int ncplane_polyfill_yx(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, const nccell* c)
functions.description: Flood-fill starting at y,x replacing contiguous regions of the same target glyph with c. Returns number of cells filled or -1 on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y and x must be valid on-plane coordinates.
c must be a valid initialized nccell.

functions.name: ncplane_gradient
functions.signature: API int ncplane_gradient(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, unsigned ylen, unsigned xlen, const char* egc, uint16_t styles, uint64_t ul, uint64_t ur, uint64_t ll, uint64_t lr)
functions.description: Fill a rectangle with a color gradient derived from four corner channels and a uniform glyph EGC/styles. Returns cells filled or -1. Palette-indexed colors are not supported unless all four corners match default color.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y/x may be -1 to use current cursor axis; otherwise must be in-bounds.
ylen/xlen: 0 means extend to boundary; otherwise region must be within plane.
egc must be a valid UTF-8 cluster.
All alpha values must match; RGB-only unless all four channels are equal default; additional 1x1/1xN/Nx1 corner equality rules per doc.

functions.name: ncplane_gradient2x1
functions.signature: API int ncplane_gradient2x1(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, unsigned ylen, unsigned xlen, uint32_t ul, uint32_t ur, uint32_t ll, uint32_t lr)
functions.description: Render a high-resolution gradient using upper blocks and synchronized backgrounds (appearing as full blocks). Returns cells filled or -1.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Region parameters as for ncplane_gradient.
Channels are 32-bit foreground/background components per corner.

functions.name: ncplane_format
functions.signature: API int ncplane_format(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, unsigned ylen, unsigned xlen, uint16_t stylemask)
functions.description: Set style bits over a rectangular region without changing content or channels. Returns number of cells set or -1.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
y/x may be -1 to use cursor; otherwise must lie on-plane.
ylen/xlen 0 mean to boundary; otherwise must be within plane.
stylemask uses NCSTYLE_* bits (lower 16 bits).

functions.name: ncplane_stain
functions.signature: API int ncplane_stain(struct ncplane* n, int y, int x, unsigned ylen, unsigned xlen, uint64_t ul, uint64_t ur, uint64_t ll, uint64_t lr)
functions.description: Set channels across a region, keeping content and styles unchanged, interpolating between four corner channels. Returns cells set or -1.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Region parameters as for ncplane_format.
Corner channels must satisfy interpolation rules; palette-index constraints as in gradients.

functions.name: ncplane_mergedown_simple
functions.signature: API int ncplane_mergedown_simple(struct ncplane* RESTRICT src, struct ncplane* RESTRICT dst)
functions.description: Merge entire src plane down onto dst as if rendering only those two planes. If they do not intersect, dst is unchanged. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
requirements: src and dst must be valid planes (non-NULL) and distinct.
Neither plane may have sprixels (per mergedown restrictions implied in full variant).

functions.name: ncplane_mergedown
functions.signature: API int ncplane_mergedown(struct ncplane* RESTRICT src, struct ncplane* RESTRICT dst, int begsrcy, int begsrcx, unsigned leny, unsigned lenx, int dsty, int dstx)
functions.description: Merge a subregion of src onto a subregion of dst at a specified destination origin. Errors if regions are out of bounds or src/dst equivalent. Neither plane may have sprixels.
requirements: src and dst must be valid, distinct planes.
begsrcy/begsrcx must identify a subregion fully within src; leny/lenx 0 mean everything left.
Projected destination rectangle must lie fully within dst at dsty/dstx.
Neither src nor dst may have sprixels.

functions.name: ncplane_erase
functions.signature: API void ncplane_erase(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Erase all cells in a plane (null glyph, default channels/styles). Homing the cursor. Base cell is preserved; plane attributes remain unchanged.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
All existing nccell references (except base cell) become invalid.

functions.name: ncplane_erase_region
functions.signature: API int ncplane_erase_region(struct ncplane* n, int ystart, int xstart, int ylen, int xlen)
functions.description: Erase a specified region relative to an origin and lengths which may be positive/negative/zero per documented semantics. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
ystart/xstart -1 use cursor axis; other negative starts are errors; non -1 starts must be on-plane.
ylen/xlen semantics: 0 clears whole axis; negative extends upward/left; positive downward/right; end may extend outside plane but start must be within.

functions.name: ncplane_set_channels
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_channels(struct ncplane* n, uint64_t channels)
functions.description: Replace the plane’s working channels with the provided 64-bit channels value.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
channels must be a valid channels pair.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bchannel
functions.signature: API uint64_t ncplane_set_bchannel(struct ncplane* n, uint32_t channel)
functions.description: Set the plane’s background channel (alpha+color) from a 32-bit value. Returns the updated 64-bit channels.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
channel must be a valid single channel value.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fchannel
functions.signature: API uint64_t ncplane_set_fchannel(struct ncplane* n, uint32_t channel)
functions.description: Set the plane’s foreground channel (alpha+color) from a 32-bit value. Returns the updated 64-bit channels.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
channel must be a valid single channel value.

functions.name: ncplane_set_styles
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_styles(struct ncplane* n, unsigned stylebits)
functions.description: Set the plane’s stylemask to stylebits (NCSTYLE_*).
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Only lower 16 bits are meaningful.

functions.name: ncplane_on_styles
functions.signature: API void ncplane_on_styles(struct ncplane* n, unsigned stylebits)
functions.description: Add the specified style bits to the plane’s current stylemask.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_off_styles
functions.signature: API void ncplane_off_styles(struct ncplane* n, unsigned stylebits)
functions.description: Remove the specified style bits from the plane’s current stylemask.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_rgb8
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_fg_rgb8(struct ncplane* n, unsigned r, unsigned g, unsigned b)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working foreground color by 8-bit RGB components. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error/downgrade constraints.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
r,g,b must be <= 255.
Terminal may downsample if truecolor is unsupported.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_rgb8
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_bg_rgb8(struct ncplane* n, unsigned r, unsigned g, unsigned b)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working background color by 8-bit RGB components.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
r,g,b must be <= 255.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_rgb8_clipped
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_bg_rgb8_clipped(struct ncplane* n, int r, int g, int b)
functions.description: Set the plane’s background color, clipping r,g,b to [0..255].
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_rgb8_clipped
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_fg_rgb8_clipped(struct ncplane* n, int r, int g, int b)
functions.description: Set the plane’s foreground color, clipping r,g,b to [0..255].
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_rgb
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_fg_rgb(struct ncplane* n, uint32_t channel)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working foreground color from a packed 24-bit RGB channel. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
channel must be <= 0xFFFFFF.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_rgb
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_bg_rgb(struct ncplane* n, uint32_t channel)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working background color from a packed 24-bit RGB channel. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
channel must be <= 0xFFFFFF.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_default
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_fg_default(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working foreground to the terminal default color.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_default
functions.signature: API void ncplane_set_bg_default(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working background to the terminal default color.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_palindex
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_fg_palindex(struct ncplane* n, unsigned idx)
functions.description: Set the plane’s foreground to a palette-indexed color at idx; marks channel as indexed and opaque, clearing default bit.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
idx must be < NCPALETTESIZE (256).

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_palindex
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_bg_palindex(struct ncplane* n, unsigned idx)
functions.description: Set the plane’s background to a palette-indexed color at idx; marks channel as indexed and opaque, clearing default bit.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
idx must be < NCPALETTESIZE (256).

functions.name: ncplane_set_fg_alpha
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_fg_alpha(struct ncplane* n, int alpha)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working foreground alpha (NCALPHA_*). Returns 0 on success, non-zero on invalid alpha.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
alpha must be a valid 2-bit NCALPHA_* value.

functions.name: ncplane_set_bg_alpha
functions.signature: API int ncplane_set_bg_alpha(struct ncplane* n, int alpha)
functions.description: Set the plane’s working background alpha (NCALPHA_*). NCALPHA_HIGHCONTRAST is forbidden for background. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
alpha must be a valid NCALPHA_*; HIGHCONTRAST is forbidden for background.

functions.name: ncplane_fadeout
functions.signature: API int ncplane_fadeout(struct ncplane* n, const struct timespec* ts, fadecb fader, void* curry)
functions.description: Fade a plane out over the specified time, invoking fader each iteration. Requires truecolor or palette modification. Returns 0 on success or fader’s non-zero code to abort.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
ts may be NULL or a valid timespec defining total time.
fader may be NULL or a valid callback; if non-NULL it may trigger render and may abort by returning non-zero.
Terminal must support RGB or palette changes for effective fading.

functions.name: ncplane_fadein
functions.signature: API int ncplane_fadein(struct ncplane* n, const struct timespec* ts, fadecb fader, void* curry)
functions.description: Fade a plane in over the specified time from black/zero to its current colors, invoking fader each iteration. Returns 0 on success or fader’s non-zero to abort.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Same capability requirements as fadeout apply.
ts/fader/curry semantics as in fadeout.

functions.name: ncfadectx_setup
functions.signature: API ALLOC struct ncfadectx* ncfadectx_setup(struct ncplane* n)
functions.description: Create a fade context for iterative fadein/fadeout operations on a plane.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
Caller must free the returned context with ncfadectx_free().

functions.name: ncfadectx_iterations
functions.signature: API int ncfadectx_iterations(const struct ncfadectx* nctx)
functions.description: Return the number of iterations the fade context will perform.
requirements: nctx must be a valid fade context pointer (non-NULL).

functions.name: ncplane_fadeout_iteration
functions.signature: API int ncplane_fadeout_iteration(struct ncplane* n, struct ncfadectx* nctx, int iter, fadecb fader, void* curry)
functions.description: Perform one specific fadeout iteration on n using nctx. iter must be less than ncfadectx_iterations(nctx). Returns 0 on success or fader’s non-zero to abort.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
nctx must be a valid fade context created by ncfadectx_setup().
iter must be within [0, iterations).
fader may be NULL or a valid callback.

functions.name: ncplane_fadein_iteration
functions.signature: API int ncplane_fadein_iteration(struct ncplane* n, struct ncfadectx* nctx, int iter, fadecb fader, void* curry)
functions.description: Perform one specific fadein iteration on n using nctx.
requirements: Same as ncplane_fadeout_iteration() with fadein semantics.

functions.name: ncplane_pulse
functions.signature: API int ncplane_pulse(struct ncplane* n, const struct timespec* ts, fadecb fader, void* curry)
functions.description: Pulse (fade in/out repeatedly) until the callback fader returns non-zero. ts defines the half-period. Caller typically prepares plane then calls pulse.
requirements: n must be a valid ncplane.
ts must be a valid timespec defining half-period.
fader must be a valid callback that orchestrates render and can terminate by returning non-zero.

functions.name: ncfadectx_free
functions.signature: API void ncfadectx_free(struct ncfadectx* nctx)
functions.description: Free a fade context previously returned by ncfadectx_setup().
requirements: nctx may be NULL or a valid fade context pointer.
Do not use nctx after freeing.

functions.name: ncvisual_from_file
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_file(const char* file)
functions.description: Open a visual from a media file path, decode the first image/frame into an ncvisual. Returns a newly allocated ncvisual or NULL on error.
requirements: file must be a valid, NUL-terminated path to a readable media file
Library must have been built with image/video loader support (FFmpeg/OIIO)
Caller takes ownership of the returned ncvisual and must later call ncvisual_destroy() on success

functions.name: ncvisual_from_rgba
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_rgba(const void* rgba, int rows, int rowstride, int cols)
functions.description: Create an ncvisual from in-memory 8bpc RGBA pixel data laid out in rows of rowstride bytes.
requirements: rows > 0
cols > 0
rowstride > 0 and a multiple of 4
rowstride >= cols * 4
rgba must point to at least rows * rowstride bytes
On success, caller must destroy with ncvisual_destroy()

functions.name: ncvisual_from_rgb_packed
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_rgb_packed(const void* rgba, int rows, int rowstride, int cols, int alpha)
functions.description: Create an ncvisual from in-memory packed 3-byte RGB data; alpha channel is uniformly set from 'alpha'.
requirements: rows > 0
cols > 0
rowstride > 0 and a multiple of 3
rowstride >= cols * 3
rgba must point to at least rows * rowstride bytes
alpha should be 0..255 (inferred typical range) though header does not explicitly constrain
On success, caller must destroy with ncvisual_destroy()

functions.name: ncvisual_from_rgb_loose
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_rgb_loose(const void* rgba, int rows, int rowstride, int cols, int alpha)
functions.description: Create an ncvisual from 4-byte RGBx data (unused byte per pixel). Alpha is uniformly set from 'alpha'.
requirements: rows > 0
cols > 0
rowstride > 0 and a multiple of 4
rowstride >= cols * 4
rgba must point to at least rows * rowstride bytes
alpha typical range 0..255 (not explicitly stated)
On success, caller must destroy with ncvisual_destroy()

functions.name: ncvisual_from_bgra
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_bgra(const void* bgra, int rows, int rowstride, int cols)
functions.description: Create an ncvisual from in-memory 8bpc BGRA pixel data (byte layout).
requirements: rows > 0
cols > 0
rowstride > 0 and a multiple of 4
rowstride >= cols * 4
bgra must point to at least rows * rowstride bytes
On success, caller must destroy with ncvisual_destroy()

functions.name: ncvisual_from_palidx
functions.signature: struct ncvisual* ncvisual_from_palidx(const void* data, int rows, int rowstride, int cols, int palsize, int pstride, const uint32_t* palette)
functions.description: Create an ncvisual from palette-indexed pixel data using a provided palette of ncchannels entries.
requirements: rows > 0
cols > 0
rowstride > 0 and a multiple of pstride
rowstride >= cols * pstride
pstride > 0
palsize > 0
